LESSON: CONSUMER SATISFACTION

Grade: Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Business and Its Environment
Topic 2.6: Consumer Satisfaction
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Consumer Satisfaction, part of Business and Its Environment in Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is consumer satisfaction important in business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  discuss and present on the meaning and importance of consumer satisfaction in business,  use digital devices or print media to search for information on the terms and conditions in supply of good and services,  share experiences on cases involving consumer satisfaction remedies for a product,  role play remedies for consumer satisfaction,  prepare a questionnaire to collect data on consumer satisfaction on the products offered within the community, and share the findings in class.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  discuss and present on the meaning and importance of consumer satisfaction in business,  use digital devices or print media to search for information on the terms and conditions in supply of good and services,  share experiences on cases involving consumer satisfaction remedies for a product,  role play remedies for consumer satisfaction,  prepare a questionnaire to collect data on consumer satisfaction on the products offered within the community, and share the findings in class.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Consumer Satisfaction together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy: The learner develops effective communication skills when sharing the findings in class on the survey regarding

customer satisfaction on products offered by the school community.

 Critical thinking and Problem solving: The learner acquires research skills when carrying out the customer survey.

 Creativity and Imagination: The learner acquires networking skills when role playing on remedies for consumer satisfaction.

 Digital literacy: The learner acquires the skills of interacting and connecting with digital technology when searching for

information on the terms and conditions in supply of good and services.

Values:
 Unity: The learner co-operates with others when preparing a questionnaire to collect data on consumer satisfaction with

regard to the products offered in the community and share the findings in class.

 Love: The learner respects others when sharing experiences on cases involving consumer satisfaction remedies for a product.

 Respect: The learner accepts diverse opinions when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of consumer

satisfaction in business.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

 Peer education and Mentorship: The learner enhances inter-personal relationships when discussing and presenting on the

meaning and importance of consumer satisfaction in business.

 Financial literacy: The learner enhances consumer literacy skills when sharing experiences on cases involving customer

satisfaction.

 Internet safety and Security: Responsible online behaviour is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to search for

information on terms and conditions in supply of good and services.
